# Adventure Park, Shivpuri (Rishikesh)

> Adventure Park is a river rafting, luxury camping and guest house business on the Badrinath Highway, near Shiv Mandir in Shivpuri, about 16 km from Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India. White-water rafting on the Ganga runs September to June. The luxury camp and the 8-room AC guest house are open all year.

## Key facts

- Address: Badrinath Highway, near Shiv Mandir, Shivpuri, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 87555 42743
- Email: adventurepark661@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/adventure_park771/
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/6zFx98TaJ3paao2v8
- Office hours: 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM, every day
- Rafting hours: 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM
- Rafting season: September to June (closed in July and August for the monsoon)
- Camping and guest house: open all year

## Rafting prices (per person)

| Trip | Route | Monday to Friday | Saturday and Sunday |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 km | Marine Drive to Shivpuri | ₹500 | ₹600 |
| 16 km | Shivpuri to NIM Beach | ₹800 | ₹960 |
| 26 km | Marine Drive to NIM Beach | ₹1,500 | ₹1,800 |
| 36 km | Kaudiyala to NIM Beach | ₹2,500 | ₹3,000 |

## Stay

- Luxury camping: ₹1,500 to ₹1,800 per person per night (quad or triple sharing), ₹1,800 to ₹2,200 (double sharing). Children aged 6 to 11 pay 50% of the adult price.
- Guest house: 8 AC rooms. ₹1,200 per room per night from July to September, ₹1,500 to ₹1,600 from October to January, ₹2,200 to ₹2,500 from February to June.

## How to book

Send a request on the website (%SITE_URL%/#book) or call or WhatsApp +91 87555 42743. Bookings are confirmed only from the official number or email above.
